user_query: My friend is organizing a surprise party for his wife and he wants to send out digital invitations. Can you recommend an email verification service to ensure the email addresses are valid? Also, he needs a temporary email address generator for creating disposable email accounts to receive RSVPs. Lastly, can you suggest a website for designing attractive e-invitations?

TaskList.description: Find a reliable email verification service to validate email addresses.
Identify a service for generating temporary email addresses for RSVPs.
Recommend a website or tool for designing attractive e-invitations.
